units.source_text: “新恋情，如果不是与旧恋完全不同，而在另一种树枝上绽开的花；

en.t: A new love, if it is not completely different from the old love, a flower blooming on another kind of branch;

units.source_text: 如果不是与旧恋完全不同，而在另一处喷涌的泉水，

en.t: if it is not completely different from the old love, a spring gushing forth in another place,

units.source_text: 那么我就不应该有新恋情。”

en.t: then I should not have a new love at all.”
